$description: Sugo AI · Viola Light — canonical design tokens. Single source of truth for every surface: web, app, document, deck, social. Hex values are the authored sRGB result of the OKLCH source; use hex anywhere OKLCH is unavailable (Word, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, Figma, print).

surface.$description: Grounds. Paper is the default page; card is the raised plane; ink is the only dark flood.

$extensions.role: Default page ground.
Alternating band / secondary ground.
Raised panel, table body, sheet stock.
Print sheet stock only. Never a web page ground.

ink.$description: Type and stroke. Navy is the principal ink, the action color, and the only dark flood.

$extensions.role: Primary type, 2px carpentry, primary button fill, dark flood.
Body copy on paper, secondary type.
Meta, captions, footnotes, rules on flood.
Hairline rules on paper. Never type.

viola.$description: The signature atmosphere. Viola is the brand's recognizable color, not an accent to be sprinkled.

$extensions.role: Supporting tint surface, ticket trays, callout ground.
Hero flood, social-card ground, theme-color. The brand viola.
Flood shade / depth within a viola field.
DECORATIVE ONLY — stacked button shadow, dividers, dots. 2.29:1 on paper: never type, never an icon carrying meaning.
Link underline, emphasis type, document accent. 4.59:1 on paper — AA for normal text.

accent.$description: One accent per composition, never two in the same section. Each carries a fixed meaning.

$extensions.role: EVIDENCE. Numbers, stats, cited findings, the one figure you want read first.
NEUTRAL DIAGRAM FILL. Reserved for architecture diagrams and system drawings. Not a marketing surface.

mark.$description: Colors that exist inside the pixel tomato and nowhere else. The mark is the only red-family element in the system.

$extensions.role: Tomato body. Never used as a UI or document color.
Tomato stem. Never used as a UI or document color.
Tomato specular pixels.
Primary button fill = ink.900.
Primary button hover.
Type on the primary button = paper.
Stacked hard shadow on primary button: 4px 4px 0.
2px focus ring on light surfaces.
2px focus ring on navy or viola floods.

status.$description: FUNCTIONAL APPLICATION UI ONLY. Never appears in marketing, website chrome, or documents. There is no danger colour: red belongs to the mark alone (B-41). An error state is an alert-circle icon, a 2px ink border, and body 600 copy.

dataviz.$description: Ordered categorical series for charts and diagrams on a paper or card ground. Use in sequence — never reorder for prettiness. Every step clears 3:1 against paper (WCAG 2.2 §1.4.11 non-text contrast). Encode with shape, label, or pattern as well as hue; never by hue alone.

$extensions.role: Headlines, panel titles, statements, button-adjacent emphasis.
All running text, UI labels, buttons.
$extensions.note: Free for commercial use. Self-hosting the webfont requires written ITF consent — load via api.fontshare.com. Desktop OTF may be installed for Word/PowerPoint; do not redistribute the font files.

$extensions.role: Numerals, eyebrows, metadata, footnotes, code, table headers. Never running prose.

document.$description: Point sizes for Letter-format documents, decks, and PDFs. Leading given as multiplier.

$extensions.role: Table cells, amounts, dates, footnotes.

space.$description: 4-pt base. Web values in rem; document equivalents in inches.
